integrity: Proof uses exhaustive exact polynomial sign checks for every labeled connected graph and nonconstant binary source through four vertices, plus closed analytic exceptional formulas; no stochastic inference or independent external validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Linear equal-turnover and equal-dispersal graph equilibrium; binary sources on connected simple graphs of 2..4 sites; unstandardized symmetric adjacency Moran and Geary indices only. No inference for larger networks or field data. Publication-priority comparison remains incomplete for one highly relevant 2008 simulation paper.
title: Sharp four-habitat nonmonotonicity of Moran autocorrelation under dispersal
